statement: Lambda lists on-demand NVIDIA B200 SXM6 8-GPU instances at $6.69 per GPU per hour.
why: A published list rate for the newest widely available rental tier is the cleanest read on what a buyer pays today for top-end capacity.

impact.mechanism: Static rental level with no stated baseline or change; carried as a display overlay only, not as a demand or supply signal.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA B200 SXM6 (180GB VRAM, 208 vCPUs, 2900GB RAM, 22TB SSD) $6.69/GPU/hr

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published price page (secondary for market-wide purposes); list rate, not transacted price, and excludes tax.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.29 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda Labs
